$comment: Dispatch MCP servers. ADR-0003 §Stage 3 + AK decision register §4 (option A, decided
2026-08-18): the Figma inbound lane is DORMANT and READ-ONLY. The entry exists so the
lane is one OAuth click from usable IF a design artifact ever originates in Figma; it is
INACTIVE until then, and nothing in the design-intent-to-code lane waits on it.
Activation is AK's one-time click in claude.ai connector settings — never a session's.
Sessions must not add write-capable Figma tooling here: write-to-canvas is beta and flagged
to become usage-based paid, and the register decided a $0 read-only posture.
Plan-tiered limits verified on figma.com/pricing 2026-08-18: Professional/Organization 200
tool calls/day (+10-15/min), Enterprise 600/day; Starter unlisted [unverified]. Re-verify at
OAuth time. Runbook: docs/runbooks/design-intent-to-code.md.
PostHog (ADR-0003 Stage 6 + register 9, decided 2026-08-18): the analytics read lane. Hosted
HTTP MCP at https://mcp.posthog.com/mcp; the server proxies to the region of the account that
signs in, so EU Cloud needs no separate endpoint (verified posthog.com/docs 2026-08-19). HTTP
transport deliberately, NOT the documented `npx mcp-remote` stdio wrapper: the house rail is
bun/bunx, never npm/npx, and a remote HTTP server needs no local process at all.
COST LAW: connecting and calling tools is free, but PostHog's AI-powered tools (the llma-* and
AI-observability families) bill as PostHog AI spend. The stage is costed at $0, so sessions and
the weekly loop stay on PLAIN HogQL — `query-sql` and the read tools. Anything that would incur
AI spend returns to AK as a decision under the ADR's $10/mo ceiling.
READ-ONLY BY POSTURE: this lane exists to ask questions of the data. It never writes to the
product, and it never authors a design change — findings are proposals under AK sign-off.

figma.$activation: AK one-time OAuth (claude.ai connector settings); conditional on a design artifact originating in Figma

posthog.$activation: AK one-time PostHog signup + OAuth; the account's region routes the proxy (EU Cloud)
posthog.$cost-law: plain HogQL only — the llma-*/AI-observability tools bill as PostHog AI spend; the stage is costed at $0
